questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for DataSentry AI API.
questions.answer: GET /health remains public. Require verified Firebase ID tokens on POST /api/analyze and POST /api/interpret. Derive the user's UID only from verified token claims. Validate bounded CSV uploads and perform deterministic in-memory Pandas analysis; after successful analysis, write only filename, row/column/missing counts, completed status, and timestamp to analysisHistory/{uid}/{analysisId} in Firebase Realtime Database. Scope cached evidence and interpretation authorization to the UID. Keep Gemini optional and backend-only; validate structured output and preserve deterministic results when AI is unavailable. Do not store CSV contents.
